commits.message:
fix(daemon): a TIMEOUT to a click means it ran nothing, and url-handle and the click helpers act on that (#942)

* fix(daemon): a TIMEOUT to a click means it ran nothing, and url-handle and the click helpers act on that

A click request read in time is answered with its own outcome instead of
being bounded by the request guard, so a TIMEOUT now means the frame was read
after the guard fired and the click was refused at its turn. url-handle tells
a refused click to be clicked again and a click its own clock cut off that the
outcome is unknown. The e2e click helper sends again on TIMEOUT and no longer
reads the daemon log for an outcome.

* fix(daemon): review pass 1 — bounded flag on answering, backstop phase named by whose clock, linkTo and click-event helpers shared

* fix(daemon): url-handle exits 0 when its own clock ended the wait, and the click exception is marked where the table takes it

* fix(daemon): the backstop's policy per request kind is one table, and a click read in time waits in its own phase

* docs(daemon): comments and docs say a click read in time escapes the backstop, and that its action did not run when refused

fix(docs): the path check asks git what the checkout holds, and the renderer's stats shape lives below both sides

The document path check read the disk and a hand-written .gitignore parser, so it failed on a built checkout and passed ignored names under directories nothing holds. The unit global setup now asks git once (tracked and untracked-not-ignored files, and which cited paths git ignores), and the test is a lookup over that answer. Top-level files are citations too, and the header says which documents are covered.

The renderer portion of the stats reply moves to its own module that both the renderer interface and the host's stats snapshot import, so the import cycle and its marked exception are gone.

fix(docs): the docs and comments stop describing removed features, and the path check covers every living doc

Sweeps the edited design docs and memory files for the update notice, the tmux status line, the Doctor and the restart of Claude Code. Names the real consumer or none in the Doctor-era comments, states the one-way-deps rule the lint enforces with the interface/stats-snapshot cycle as a marked exception, restores the per-feed-key frame memory and tmux OSC 8 traps, and makes the path check derive its documents, prefixes and relative links from the tree and require a glob to match a file.

fix(docs): living docs cite only paths that exist, and the Doctor is named as retired wherever it was a live reader

A unit test now reads the memory files, CLAUDE.md and the host/renderer design
docs and fails on any cited repo path that is not on disk.

Design docs: host-and-renderer states what the interface carries (subscription
kinds, origin, write targets, how frames reach a surface, the one-way-deps
exception) and drops the false claims; the gather gap and clicks docs no longer
describe a tmux click binding nothing writes; the inventory files keep only
what the code still does.

Memory: the decisions book, refresh interval, lane-held-by-declaration reason
and diagnostic identity say what is true, with identifiers removed.

Comment-only edits in src, scripts and rust-client replace the retired Doctor
as a named reader with the readers that exist.

docs(design): the design docs and memory files say what the code does now

host-and-renderer.md points at the renderer interface instead of copying it,
states Address as object keys with arrays addressed whole, and describes the
host's start and environment as they are (no LaunchAgent is written; launchd
stays planned). The inventory cites files that exist and counts the verbs the
code declares. Memory drops identifiers, the removed tmux status line, click
restart and Doctor-as-living lines, and states a diagnostic's identity as
producers name it.
